chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from the one who mentioned it, from Hafs ibn Umar, from Salim, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever withholds a Qirat of the Zakat, let him die if he wills a Jew or a Christian.

key_terms.قِيرَاط: A small unit of weight or currency, often used to denote a minimal amount

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of withholding a small amount of Zakat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the withholding of even a minimal amount of Zakat (a Qirat) to apostasy, emphasizing that this specific act severs one's connection to the Islamic community. This hadith is central to the Shia jurisprudence of Zakat, illustrating how neglecting this pillar can result in a loss of faith status, often interpreted as a transition to the 'People of the Book' in a spiritual or communal sense.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from the one who mentioned it, from Hafs Bin Umar, from Salim, from Abu Baseer,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who prevents a carat of Zakāt, so let him die, if he so desires to as a Jew, or a Christian’.
en.sarwar: 14. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from those whom he has mentioned from Hafs ibn ‘Umar from Salim from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one (Muslim) who does not pay zakat dies as a Jew or a Christian; (he is given the chance to choose).”
